## PCA

```{r pca-plot, echo=FALSE}
library(ggplot2)
library(ggfortify)
library(tibble)

file.input <- "/mnt/rdisk/tuanthanh/NIPT/NiPTUNE/results_ilu/pca_bins/PCA_bins.csv"  # Input data file (_df)
metadata.input <- "/mnt/rdisk/tuanthanh/NIPT/NiPTUNE/results_ilu/tables/despina.tsv"
#file.output <- args[2]  # Output file name for the SVG plot

# Read the input data
df1 <- read.table(file.input, header = TRUE, sep = ";", row.names = 1, check.names = FALSE)
# Remove columns where the sum is zero
data.without0val <- df1[, colSums(df1) > 0, drop = FALSE]
# Remove columns where variance is zero
data.without0val <- data.without0val[, apply(data.without0val, 2, var, na.rm = TRUE) != 0, drop = FALSE]
# Check if there are enough columns and rows for PCA
if (ncol(data.without0val) < 2) {
  stop("Error: Not enough variables (columns) to perform PCA. At least two are required.")
}
if (nrow(data.without0val) < 2) {
  stop("Error: Not enough observations (rows) to perform PCA. At least two are required.")
}

pca1 <- prcomp(data.without0val, center = TRUE, scale. = TRUE)

# Calculate the proportion of variance explained by each component
percent_var <- pca1$sdev^2 / sum(pca1$sdev^2) * 100

# Prepare labels for PC1 and PC2 with percentage of variance
x_label <- paste0("PC1 (", round(percent_var[1], 2), "%)")
y_label <- paste0("PC2 (", round(percent_var[2], 2), "%)")

# Extract PCA scores (the coordinates of each sample in the new PCA space)
pca_scores <- as.data.frame(pca1$x)

df2 <- read.table(metadata.input, header = TRUE, sep = "\t", row.names = 1, check.names = FALSE)

merged_data <- merge(pca_scores, df2, by = "row.names")
colnames(merged_data)[colnames(merged_data) == "read number"] <- "sequencing_depth"

# Basic PCA plot with metadata
p <- ggplot(merged_data, aes(x = PC1, y = PC2)) +
  geom_point(size = 3, color = "darkgreen") +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(title = "PCA Plot with SD", x = x_label, y = y_label) +
  theme(legend.position = "right")

# Calculate the distance of each point to the cluster center (mean of PC1 and PC2)
cluster_center <- colMeans(merged_data[, c("PC1", "PC2")])
merged_data$distance_to_center <- sqrt((merged_data$PC1 - cluster_center[1])^2 + (merged_data$PC2 - cluster_center[2])^2)

# Get the names of the 3 points with the largest distance to the cluster center
ordered_scores <- merged_data[order(-merged_data$distance_to_center), ]
top2_outliers <- ordered_scores[1:2, "Row.names"]

# Add text labels for the top 3 outliers, mapping the label to the center of the point
p <- p + geom_text(aes(label = ifelse(Row.names %in% top2_outliers, Row.names, "")), vjust = -1, hjust = 0.5)

p 
```

# Gender Prediction & Fetal Fraction

## Z-Score for Trisomies 13, 18, 21

**Condition:**

-   Red: Z-score greater than threshold
-   Blue: Z-score less than threshold
-   Gray: Z-score in the gray zone

```{r z-score-table, echo=FALSE}
# Display the table using reactable with central alignment
thalassa_data <- thalassa_data %>%
  mutate(Label = case_when(
    `Z-score chr13` > 5 ~ "Trisomy 13",
    `Z-score chr13` < -5 ~ "Monosomy 13",
    `Z-score chr18` > 5 ~ "Trisomy 18",
    `Z-score chr18` < -5 ~ "Monosomy 18",
    `Z-score chr21` > 5 ~ "Trisomy 21",
    `Z-score chr21` < -5 ~ "Monosomy 21",
    TRUE ~ "Normal"
  ))

# Display the table using reactable with central alignment, conditional formatting, and labeling
reactable(
  thalassa_data,
  columns = setNames(lapply(names(thalassa_data), function(col) {
    if (col %in% tail(names(thalassa_data), 4)) {
      colDef(
        name = col,
        align = "center",
        cell = if (col != "Label") {
          function(value) {
            # Determine the color based on the value
            color <- if (value > 5) {
              "red"
            } else if (value < -5) {
              "blue"
            } else if (value >= 4.0 && value <= 6.0) {
              "gray"
            } else {
              "black"
            }
            sprintf("<span style='color:%s;'>%.4f</span>", color, round(value, 4))
          }
        } else {
          NULL  # No special formatting for the label column
        },
        html = TRUE
      )
    } else {
      colDef(name = col, align = "center")
    }
  }), names(thalassa_data)),
  searchable = TRUE,
  sortable = TRUE,
  defaultPageSize = 10,
  highlight = TRUE,
  bordered = TRUE,
  filterable = TRUE
)
```

# Z-Score Results (Full)

## By Chromosome

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
# Load and process data
sao_data <- readr::read_tsv("/mnt/rdisk/tuanthanh/NIPT/NiPTUNE/results_ilu/tables/sao.tsv", 
                     col_types = cols()) %>%
  dplyr::select(-last_col()) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~ round(., 4)))
```

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| warning: false

# Create named list of column definitions
col_defs <- list()
for (col_name in names(sao_data)) {
  if (col_name == names(sao_data)[1]) {  # First column (sample names)
    col_defs[[col_name]] <- colDef(
      name = "Sample",
      width = 150,
      sticky = "left"
    )
  } else {  # Z-score columns
    col_defs[[col_name]] <- colDef(
      name = col_name,
      format = colFormat(digits = 4),
      style = function(value) {
        color <- if (value > 5) {
          "red"
        } else if (value < -5) {
          "blue"
        } else if (value >= 4.0 && value <= 6.0) {
          "darkgray"
        } else {
          "black"
        }
        list(color = color)
      }
    )
  }
}

# Create the reactable with named column definitions
reactable(
  sao_data,
  columns = col_defs,
  filterable = TRUE,
  searchable = TRUE,
  bordered = TRUE,
  striped = TRUE,
  highlight = TRUE,
  defaultPageSize = 15,
  showPageSizeOptions = TRUE,
  pageSizeOptions = c(15, 30, 50, 100)
)
```

# Sample Images Report

```{r, echo=FALSE}
# Base path to the directories
base_path <- "/mnt/rdisk/tuanthanh/NIPT/NiPTUNE/results_ilu/copy_number_alteration_data/"

# Output directory for accessible image paths
output_dir <- "images"
dir.create(output_dir, showWarnings = FALSE)

# Function to retrieve genome_wide.png paths from sample directories
get_sample_images <- function(base_path, output_dir) {
  # List all directories ending with .plots
  sample_dirs <- dir_ls(base_path, type = "directory", glob = "*.plots")
  
  # Map over directories to get the genome_wide.png file
  sample_images <- map_df(sample_dirs, function(dir) {
    png <- file.path(dir, "genome_wide.png")
    if (file.exists(png)) {
      # Copy to output directory with a unique name
      dest <- file.path(output_dir, basename(dir))
      dir.create(dest, showWarnings = FALSE)
      file.copy(png, file.path(dest, basename(png)))
      tibble(
        sample = basename(dir) %>% str_remove("\\.plots$"),  # Remove .plots extension
        image_path = file.path(dest, basename(png))
      )
    } else {
      NULL
    }
  })
  
  return(sample_images)
}

# Get the list of images
sample_images <- get_sample_images(base_path, output_dir)

# Create a reactable table for the samples
reactable(
  sample_images,
  columns = list(
    sample = colDef(name = "Sample Name"),
    image_path = colDef(
      name = "Image Preview",
      cell = function(value) {
        sprintf(
          "<a href='%s' target='_blank'><img src='%s' style='height:200px; width:300px;'></a>",
          value, value
        )  # Adds zoom functionality by linking to full-size image
      },
      html = TRUE
    )
  ),
  searchable = TRUE,
  sortable = TRUE,
  defaultPageSize = 5,
  highlight = TRUE
)
```
